goal: Build the desktop-only assign-contacts selection surface: server paging, hidden-selected count, whole-set facets from dialer_contact_profiles, the scoped caller picker, weight inputs and a live distribution preview — with no write yet.
outcome: An admin-surface user can select contacts in their scope across pages with an explicit hidden-selected count, filter by whole-set centre/level/gender/language facets, choose a campaign and one or more callers from the AD-3 assignable set with weights, and see a live distribution preview; the primary action previews and is disabled at zero selection; a narrow viewport gets an explicit open-on-desktop state.

requirements.statement: DESKTOP ONLY. A narrow viewport gets an explicit 'open this on a desktop' state. Do not invent a phone admin grid.
FACETS COME FROM THE WHOLE SET, never the current page. A contact without a profile row is fully callable; missing values give an empty option list, never a crash.
PAGING IS CORRECTNESS. Exactly 1000-row PostgREST cap, ~1030 folk contacts. Use the shared pager from lib/supabase/manage.ts; do not write a bare .range() loop.
The hidden-selected indicator is load-bearing — without it an admin assigns the wrong people.
Weights are UI state only; never store them and never add a weights table.
